text: dsh-task-board（DSH 网页端插件）：在侧边栏提供可持久保存、可审阅的任务看板。它把 Host 服务、Session 桥接和浏览器界面作为一个 Loader 插件组合安装，并将任务数据存入 DSH Storage Domain。用户可创建和编辑任务卡，填写验收标准、工作目录或 Workspace、Agent Preset 与图片附件；启动任务后通过普通 DSH Session 执行，可查看活动和历史、追加后续提示、停止或重试，并审核完成结果、批准或附反馈退回。适合希望在 Web 界面跟踪并审阅多轮 Agent 工作的用户；只有启动 Agent 任务时才需要已配置的模型凭据。

dsh-task-board adds a durable task board to DSH Web in one Loader plugin. Create and edit cards, run tasks through DSH Sessions, review history, send follow-ups, stop or retry runs, and approve or return work with feedback. Model credentials are needed only for Agent runs.
想用看板记录需要 Agent 完成并逐项验收的工作。
希望把任务卡、工作目录和验收条件放在一个 DSH 页面里管理。
DSH 能不能让我启动任务后再审核 Agent 的结果？
想查看每个任务执行轮次的活动记录和 Session 历史。
I want a sidebar board for creating and reviewing Agent tasks in DSH.
Can I send feedback and have an agent continue work on a task?
I need durable task cards that connect to ordinary DSH sessions.
dsh-task-board 功能「任务卡管理」：创建、编辑、排序、重新打开或删除任务卡，并为任务填写描述、验收标准、工作目录、Agent Preset 和图片附件。
dsh-task-board 功能「启动与控制执行」：从任务卡启动普通 DSH Session，查看运行状态，并可停止当前执行或在失败后重试。
dsh-task-board 功能「结果审核与后续轮次」：查看已完成结果，批准任务或附反馈退回；运行中的任务也可追加后续提示。
dsh-task-board feature “Execution history”: View task activity and related Session history in the browser.
想把 Agent 的任务分轮执行，并保存每轮的状态和提示记录。

dsh-task-board README · DSH Task Board：[中文说明](README.zh.md)

`dsh-task-board` is a community plugin for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness). It adds a durable task board to the Web profile as one installable package and one Loader entry.

The package includes the Host service, Session bridge, generated Typert RPC contribution, and browser UI. Users install one repository; the plugin adds only the `task-board` row to the profile configuration.

dsh-task-board README · Requirements：- DeepSeek Harness `0.1.0-rc.6`
- Node.js `^22.19.0` or `>=24`
- `pnpm` available on `PATH`, as required by `npx @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin`
- A configured model credential only when a task should run an agent; browsing and editing the board do not require one

dsh-task-board README · Install：```sh
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile web add github:scwlkq/dsh-task-board
```

This runs the official DSH CLI through `npx`; no global `dsh` installation is required.

Confirm that the bundle contributes one row:

```sh
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh --profile web --dump-config
```

The output contains one `task-board` Loader row supplied by `dsh-task-board`. Start the Web profile:

```sh
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web
```

dsh-task-board README · Install：Open the printed local URL, then select **Task Board** in the sidebar. The Settings plugin list shows this extension as one `task-board` entry rather than separate Host, RPC, and UI packages.

dsh-task-board README · Features：- Create durable task cards with a title, description, acceptance criteria, workspace or working directory, Agent Preset, and image attachments
- Edit, reorder, reopen, and delete cards
- Start or stop task execution through ordinary DSH Sessions
- Review completed work, approve it, reject it with feedback, send follow-up work, or retry a failed round
- Inspect round activity and Session history
- Refresh the browser projection from the authoritative Host snapshot without requiring a custom event-forwarding patch in DSH
dsh-task-board README · Features：Task records use the profile's DSH storage. Removing the browser plugin does not silently submit or modify tasks.

dsh-task-board README · Update and remove：Update the installed Git dependency:

```sh
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile web update dsh-task-board
```

Remove the bundle and its Loader row:

```sh
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-task-board
```

dsh-task-board README · Develop locally：```sh
pnpm install
pnpm run typecheck
pnpm run build
pnpm test

The repository commits `lib/` so GitHub installation does not depend on `prepare`, `install`, or another lifecycle build script. `pnpm pack --dry-run --json` shows the same prebuilt runtime files shipped in a release tarball.
